title: The Sopranos
description:
S01 E01 — The Sopranos
New Jersey mafioso Tony Soprano seeks psychiatric help from a doctor after experiencing anxiety attacks, giving her details about his relatives and their problems.

title: The Sopranos
description:
S05 E12 — Long Term Parking
When Adriana tries to cover up a murder, the FBI continues to follow her, this time with tragic consequences. Meanwhile, Tony and Carmela reconcile; and Tony must take a stand for his cousin.

title: The Sopranos
description:
S05 E13 — All Due Respect
Johnny Sack turns up the heat; Carmela counts her blessings; Christopher has an unexpected visitor; A.J. demonstrates his business acumen.

title: The Sopranos
description:
S06 E01 — Members Only
Tony ponders an associate's retirement request; Junior takes Tony on a backyard treasure hunt; Hesh seeks restitution for a wrong perpetrated against his son-in-law.

title: The Sopranos
description:
S06 E02 — Join the Club
Tony runs into some trouble on a business trip to the West Coast. Christopher decides to discuss terrorism with the FBI. Meanwhile, the New Jersey family ends up mourning the loss of another one of their associates.

title: The Sopranos
description:
S06 E03 — Mayham
Silvio divides the spoils from Paulie's latest score; Carmela turns to an unexpected source for help with AJ; Christopher turns to an old writing acquaintance.

title: The Sopranos
description:
S06 E04 — The Fleshy Part of the Thigh
No one is happy when it's revealed that Barone Sanitation has been put up for sale. Paulie has a family matter that turns his world upside down. Bobby decides to help out a hopeful rapper by helping him pad his resume.

title: The Sopranos
description:
S06 E05 — Mr. & Mrs. John Sacrimoni Request ...
Johnny Sack seeks permission from the prison to be released long enough to attend his daughter's wedding. Meanwhile, Tony thinks it is time to be on the lookout for some personal protection.

title: The Sopranos
description:
S06 E06 — Live Free or Die
Tony has some decisions to make. His first involves seeking out help from Italy to solve the local problem of Rusty, while his second decision involves whether to allow one of his top earners to have a second chance.

title: The Sopranos
description:
S06 E07 — Luxury Lounge
A rival restaurant and a staff scandal jeopardize Artie's business; Christopher and Little Carmine pursue a new venture.

title: The Sopranos
description:
S06 E08 — Johnny Cakes
Tony decides to mull on a real estate deal. A.J. decides that he wants to expand his horizons. Vito is in awe of an act of bravery.

title: The Sopranos
description:
S06 E09 — The Ride
Christopher makes an announcement; Paulie cuts costs at an Italian street fair; Tony embraces the old school.

title: The Sopranos
description:
S06 E10 — Moe 'n' Joe
Tony leverages Johnny's misfortune into a domestic upgrade for Janice; a street gang attacks Bobby Bacala.

title: The Sopranos
description:
S06 E11 — Cold Stones
Carmela begins to rethink her life after she goes out for a day with Rosalie. Meadow decides it's time to find a new place to live. Tony and the gang suddenly find themselves in a place they have never been before -- lacking funds.

title: Stax: Soulsville, U.S.A.
description:
S01 E01 — Chapter One: Cause I Love You
Executives and musicians at Stax Records, an influential record label on the Black music scene in the late 1950s in Memphis, look for ways to transcend racial divides and bring their music into the American mainstream.

title: Stax: Soulsville, U.S.A.
description:
S01 E02 — Chapter Two: Soul Man
Stax breaks through to the white market with the hit "Soul Man"; the death of Stax star Otis Redding, the assassination of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr., legal obstacles and ongoing racial tensions in Memphis reveal cracks in the company's façade.

title: Stax: Soulsville, U.S.A.
description:
S01 E03 — Chapter Three: Respect Yourself
Stax promotions director Al Bell steps up to save the company after the death of Otis Redding and the Atlantic Records merger; Stax puts its efforts behind Isaac Hayes, who receives awards for his work.

title: Stax: Soulsville, U.S.A.
description:
S01 E04 — Chapter Four: Nothing Takes the Place of You
In the 1970s, a booming Stax expands to Los Angeles and gives back to the black community with the benefit concert "Wattstax," but when their bank goes under and the company faces other legal setbacks, Stax prepares to shutter its doors.

description: Donna Summer creates music that takes her from the avant-garde scene in Germany to the glitter and bright lights of dance clubs in New York; features never-before-seen home video footage and interviews with friends, family and colleagues.

title: The Moment
description: As her arena tour debut looms, a pop star finds herself caught inside the afterglow of a breakout summer under the mounting pressure of what it costs to stay on top.

title: While We're Young
description: While grappling with the changes brought by middle age, a filmmaker (Ben Stiller) and his wife (Naomi Watts) find their stagnant lives reinvigorated by their friendship with a couple of twentysomething hipsters.

description: A woman who has miraculously remained young for nearly 80 years meets a charismatic philanthropist who reawakens her passion for life and romance.

title: Babygirl

title: Pearl
description: Trapped on an isolated farm, Pearl must tend to her ailing father under the watch of her mother. Lusting for the glamorous life she's seen in movies, Pearl's temptations and repressions collide.

title: X
description: A group of actors sets out to make an adult film in rural Texas under the noses of their reclusive hosts, but when the elderly couple catches their young guests in the act, the cast finds themselves in a desperate fight for their lives.

title: MaXXXine
description: Aspiring movie star and hustler Maxine Minx finally gets her big break. But as a mysterious killer stalks the starlets of 1980s Hollywood, a trail of blood threatens to reveal her sinister past.

title: Us

title: The Conjuring: Last Rites
description: In 1986 paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren travel to Pennsylvania to vanquish a demon from a family's home.

title: Talk to Me
description: Karo is freshly separated and is struggling with the non-existing relationship with her father; when her mother Michaela wants to go on vacation with her to Rügen, Karo suspects there is again some failed love affair behind it.

title: Insidious: The Last Key
